title.rendered: Word of the Day : INCOMPLETE PROCESSES

content.rendered:
“And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin
covered them above: but there was no breath in them.”
(Ezekiel 37: 8)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

As Ezekiel prophesied, the flesh came and the skin covered them above. The human
body comprises of several components besides the flesh and skin. A complete human
body has eyes, kidneys and other organs; those components were not mentioned, only
the flesh and top skin came together. What came together was incomplete.

Despite the fact that the package was incomplete, God performed a huge miracle. Some
components were missing, but God did what He wanted to do. Jehovah was involved, and
despite the incomplete process, the result was inevitable.

Friend, if Jehovah is involved in your life, the processes may be incomplete, but
your results are inevitable. You may not have all you should have, but God will
grant you amazing results. You may not have all the finances you need for certain
projects and plans, but God will bring those plans and projects to fulfillment
supernaturally. Everything you need to be a success may not be available to you, but
God will fill the gaps and give you supernatural results.

Things may not be complete in the economy, people in power may not like your face,
you may not have what men say you need, but if God is on your side, He will make up
for what you don’t have, and you will succeed. Everything may be missing, but if God
is not missing, nothing will spoil.

If Jehovah is involved, what you don’t have won’t stop you. The contacts you don’t
have won’t stop you; the missing links in your path won’t stop you. If you walk by
God’s word and do what you are in a position to do, God will handle what you can’t
handle.

Pray With Me: Lord, the processes may be incomplete, but my results are inevitable,
in Jesus’ name!
